simplicity-r1-f1.rationale: R10's recompute-and-compare check is defensive plumbing for a scenario AC-11 already discourages. The interview only said 'computed not asserted'; that's a writer-side characterisation, not a runtime enforcement mandate. Drop the enforcement; keep the documentation-level read-only contract.
simplicity-r1-f1.revision_applied: R10 simplified to: 'sprint-bucket is written by specflow:task and is read-only for downstream consumers. The skill does not document hand-edit affordances; AC-11 is the only verify step.' AC-12 dropped. Phase D verify-step list collapses correspondingly.

simplicity-r1-f2.rationale: Single-rule fixpoint definition is more explicit than two-rule overlay.
simplicity-r1-f2.revision_applied: R2 rewritten as a single rule: bucket(T) = 1 if T has no predecessors and no same-bucket scope conflicts with an earlier-ID task; otherwise bucket(T) = 1 + max(bucket(P) for P in Depends-on(T) ∪ EarlierIDSameBucketScopeConflicts(T)).

simplicity-r1-f3.rationale: R2's rule guarantees the topological floor by construction. R9 is checking a property the algorithm can't violate.
simplicity-r1-f3.revision_applied: R9 dropped. Topological floor noted as a one-line corollary inside R2 rather than promoted to a runtime verify step.

simplicity-r1-f4.rationale: After dropping R9 and R10's enforcement, the phase-ordering reduces to two steps. Drop verbatim-listing requirement.
simplicity-r1-f4.revision_applied: R7 simplified to a behavioural property; AC-13 rewritten as a property check (not verbatim-listing). Per codex-r1-f4, an execution-order verify-step is added with a fixture (oversize task).

simplicity-r1-f5.rationale: Lexicographic-vs-natural-number disambiguation is itself a footgun.
simplicity-r1-f5.revision_applied: R2 + AC-9 reworded: 'numeric ordering on the integer suffix of the task ID (T-2 before T-10).' Per TBC-2, the canonical task ID grammar is now T-<int>(\.<letter>)? with a typed comparator.

surgical-r1-f1.rationale: Same as simplicity-r1-f1 — drop R10 enforcement.

surgical-r1-f2.rationale: Restate R7 as property; drop verbatim-listing AC.

surgical-r1-f3.rationale: R9 promoted a heuristic input to a separate verify; same as simplicity-r1-f3.

surgical-r1-f4.revision_applied: AC-3's 'or fixture under examples/' alternative dropped. Worked example lives in task/SKILL.md.

surgical-r1-f5.rationale: R8's licence for prose tightening risks drive-by edits. Reframe as chain-don't-absorb.
surgical-r1-f5.revision_applied: R8 reworded: 'task/SKILL.md ≤500 after the change set. If additions push the file over, the change set MUST split into a follow-up sub-skill or sibling doctrine doc — do not co-mingle prose edits unrelated to sprint-bucket.' Per DA-5, the heuristic + worked example are extracted into templates/task/sprint-bucket-heuristic.md (mirroring 029's templates/admin/single-context-task.md).

tbc-r1-f1.rationale: DAG assumption is load-bearing; cycles produce undefined output.
tbc-r1-f1.revision_applied: Added R11: pre-bucketing graph-validity step rejects cycles, self-loops, dangling refs with a deterministic GRAPH-INVALID diagnostic. AC-14 verifies via fixtures (one per case).

tbc-r1-f2.rationale: Task ID format isn't 'T<int>' — actual codebase uses T-<int> with optional .A/.B suffix from 029's split flow.
tbc-r1-f2.revision_applied: R2 + AC-9 reworded: canonical ID grammar T-<int>(\.<letter>)?; tie-break is a typed comparator over (int, optional-letter) pair. Worked example in AC-3 includes T-2 < T-10 to prevent string-lex regression.

tbc-r1-f3.rationale: Within-feature uniqueness was implied; state explicitly.
tbc-r1-f3.revision_applied: R2 preamble: 'Task IDs are unique within a feature; bucket assignment relies on this uniqueness for the typed-comparator tie-break to be defined.' Cross-feature collisions remain out-of-scope per R5.

tbc-r1-f4.rationale: 020 mapping is a hypothesis, not a contract.
tbc-r1-f4.revision_applied: R5 trace tagged as hypothesis: 'Per the current 020 design hypothesis (FEATURES.md § 020 — open design)... If 020's mapping evolves, 025's feature-scoping should be re-examined.'

tbc-r1-f5.revision_applied: R2 extended: 'Bumps applied iteratively until no same-bucket scope overlap remains. In each pass, walk same-bucket task pairs in (bucket-asc, T-id-asc, T-id-asc) order and bump the later-ID partner; repeat passes until a pass produces zero bumps (fixed point). Termination is guaranteed because each bump strictly increases bucket numbers and the topological-floor invariant bounds the maximum.'

goal-driven-r1-f1.rationale: Mandatory eval-coverage finding. task/SKILL.md eval doesn't exercise sprint-bucket.
goal-driven-r1-f1.revision_applied: Added R12: extends task/SKILL.md eval field with two clauses — (1) every task has sprint-bucket: N field with N≥1; (2) for every task T_i, every T_j in T_i.Depends-on has sprint-bucket strictly less than T_i.sprint-bucket. AC-15 verifies.

goal-driven-r1-f2.rationale: AC-9's grep `^sprint-bucket:` doesn't match the actual file format (markdown bullets `- **sprint-bucket:**`).
goal-driven-r1-f2.revision_applied: AC-9 rewritten with markdown-aware extraction: python3 regex over the synthesised file emits (task_id, sprint-bucket) pairs sorted by typed-comparator; diff between two runs returns empty.

goal-driven-r1-f3.rationale: AC-13 verifies doc, not execution. Add execution-order fixture.
goal-driven-r1-f3.revision_applied: AC-13 split: (a) doc lists ordering; (b) fixture with oversize task aborts before any sprint-bucket: N is written for that task; verify via grep-stderr for budget-overrun warning + grep-tasks-file for absence of sprint-bucket on the oversize task ID.

goal-driven-r1-f4.rationale: AC-12 dropped per simplicity-r1-f1 / surgical-r1-f1. Hand-edit-detection is no longer in the PRD.

goal-driven-r1-f5.rationale: Edge cases (self-loop, cycle, duplicate ID, dangling ref) need binary AC.
goal-driven-r1-f5.revision_applied: AC-14 covers four malformed-graph cases with verbatim diagnostic prefix GRAPH-INVALID: <subtype>. Per R11.

goal-driven-r1-f6.rationale: AC-7 / AC-10 absence-of-text checks were soft. Tighten to closed token list.
goal-driven-r1-f6.revision_applied: AC-7 rewritten as positive structural assertion: two independent feature-fixtures synthesised; no shared file under plugins/specflow/skills/ references both feature IDs alongside a sprint-bucket. AC-10 rewritten with closed token list (auto-tune, auto-detect, DAG, visualisation, visualization, render); grep returns only matches inside explicit Non-goals call-out.

da-r1-f1.rationale: R10 + AC-12 dropped (simplicity-r1-f1 / surgical-r1-f1). The scope-change circular-diagnostic concern dies with the enforcement.

da-r1-f2.rationale: 022 hasn't shipped; can't claim it owns auto-tuning.
da-r1-f2.revision_applied: Non-goals: 'Auto-detecting the optimal number of buckets is out of scope; whether it lands in 022 or a future feature is a separate planning decision (FEATURES.md § 022 currently scopes 022 as task-merge/split/re-order, not bucket-count tuning).'

da-r1-f3.rationale: task/SKILL.md doesn't have a 'Phase D verify-steps' — verify lives in B.4 + tail. Wrong placement claim.
da-r1-f3.revision_applied: All 'Phase D verify-steps' references replaced with 'Phase B.4 self-check' (where 029's budget check already lives) AND a new B.4 subsection cited from B.3. The heuristic itself is extracted to templates/task/sprint-bucket-heuristic.md per DA-5; B.4 carries one-line citations.

da-r1-f4.revision_applied: Users section: 020 moved to a 'Downstream consumers (informational)' note that disclaims contract authority.

da-r1-f5.rationale: 14-line headroom is unrealistic. Chain-don't-absorb (extract heuristic into a sibling doctrine doc) is the right move.
da-r1-f5.revision_applied: R8 routes the heuristic + worked example to templates/task/sprint-bucket-heuristic.md (mirrors 029's templates/admin/single-context-task.md). task/SKILL.md additions limited to one sub-section + the field-emission line in B.3.

codex-r1-f2.rationale: AC-9 needs canonical (task_id, bucket) pairs sorted by typed comparator.
codex-r1-f2.revision_applied: AC-9 uses python3 regex extraction over the markdown bullet format; pairs sorted by typed comparator.

codex-r1-f3.revision_applied: Typed comparator over (int, optional-letter) replaces lex; AC-3 worked example includes T-2 < T-10.

codex-r1-f5.rationale: Topological floor invariant should be strictly less-than after bumps; the rule definition (bucket(T) = 1 + max(bucket(D))) guarantees strict-less-than by construction; tighten language.
codex-r1-f5.revision_applied: R2's corollary states strict-less-than (T_j.sprint-bucket < T_i.sprint-bucket for every T_j in T_i.Depends-on). R12's eval clause 2 mirrors. AC-15's verify uses strict-less-than.

summary: Accepted 27 of 31 findings. Two push-backs would have required walking back interview-resolved decisions; three findings became moot when R10/AC-12 (hand-edit enforcement) was dropped. Major revisions: heuristic extracted to templates/task/sprint-bucket-heuristic.md (mirrors 029's chain-don't-absorb pattern); R10 enforcement dropped; R9 invariant-check dropped (R2's rule guarantees by construction); canonical task ID grammar T-<int>(\.<letter>)? with typed comparator; graph-validity step (R11/AC-14) for cycle/self-loop/dangling-ref/duplicate-ID; eval field extended (R12/AC-15); markdown-aware AC-9 extraction; Phase B.4 (not Phase D) is the home for verify-steps. Final R count: 12, AC count: 15.
